globalAnalysis.visualFlow: Two opposing human groups reach horizontally across a bright central gap, concentrating the scene in the near-touch of two hands.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: The score should preserve the charged silence between Adam and God; bodies carry legato motion, earth remains grounded, and the empty ether creates rests.

cells.label: Architectural edge and pale ether
cells.interpretation: A hard architectural edge opens into broad pale space.

cells.label: Open ether above the reach
cells.interpretation: Bright open space holds the silence before contact.

cells.label: Crimson host entering
cells.interpretation: The divine group presses into the open field from the right.

cells.label: Cloak and flying bodies
cells.interpretation: Overlapping limbs and fabric create forceful outward momentum.

cells.label: Adam awakening
cells.interpretation: Adam lifts his attention from the grounded landscape.

cells.label: Adam's reaching hand
cells.interpretation: A relaxed arm extends into the central charged emptiness.

cells.label: God reaching outward
cells.interpretation: God's directed gesture pushes energy toward Adam across the gap.

cells.label: Divine group under the cloak
cells.interpretation: Compressed bodies circulate within the protective red shell.

cells.label: Adam grounded on earth
cells.interpretation: The heavy reclining body remains connected to the earth.

cells.label: Near touch and luminous gap
cells.interpretation: The tiny distance between fingertips contains the scene's greatest tension.

cells.label: Divine arm and sheltering bodies
cells.interpretation: The arm continues backward into a dense network of supporting bodies.

cells.label: Trailing divine limbs
cells.interpretation: Flying limbs trail behind the forward divine gesture.

cells.label: Adam's dark earthly base
cells.interpretation: Adam's lower body settles into dense dark earth.

cells.label: Body extending across the hillside
cells.interpretation: The long body follows the earth's diagonal toward the center.

cells.label: Open lower ether and green ribbon
cells.interpretation: A loose green ribbon falls through otherwise open luminous space.

cells.label: Trailing feet and frame
cells.interpretation: The divine group tapers into feet and architectural boundary.
